keyWhy.ko: 핵심은 «샘이 점심 도시락을 집에 두고 왔다(문제)» 와 «벤이 샌드위치 반쪽과 사과를 준다(해결)» 입니다. 초록색 문장이 정답이에요.
keyWhy.en: The key ideas are the problem (Sam forgot his lunch at home) and the solution (Ben gives him half of his sandwich and an apple). The green sentences are the answers.

sumHowto.ko: 먼저 위 세 칸을 보고, 빈칸에 알맞은 단어를 고르세요.
sumHowto.en: Look at the three boxes, then choose the right word for each blank.

words: the meal in the middle of the day
Oh no, he forgot his lunch at home!
the part of your body where food goes

giving part of what you have to others

qs.q: Why does Sam's stomach make a loud noise?
qs.qko: 샘의 배에서 왜 큰 소리가 나나요?
opts: He forgot his lunch, so he is hungry.
evs: Oh no, he forgot his lunch at home!
"Thank you, Ben!" says Sam with a big smile.
Sharing makes both friends feel good.
At lunch, Sam opens his bag.
why: 샘은 도시락을 집에 두고 와서 먹을 것이 없어요. 그래서 배가 고파 꼬르륵 소리가 나요.
Sam forgot his lunch at home, so he has nothing to eat and is hungry.

qs.q: "Ben gives Sam half of his sandwich." What does "half" mean?
qs.qko: «half of his sandwich» 에서 «half» 는 무슨 뜻일까요?
evs: Ben gives Sam half of his sandwich and an apple.
His stomach makes a loud noise.
His friend Ben sees his sad face.
Sharing makes both friends feel good.
why: «half» 는 «반» 이에요. 벤은 샌드위치를 둘로 나눠 한쪽을 줘요.
"Half" means one of two same parts. Ben gives one part of his sandwich.

qs.q: How do we know Ben is a kind friend?
qs.qko: 벤이 친절한 친구라는 것을 어떻게 알 수 있나요?
opts: He sees Sam's sad face and shares his lunch.
evs: His friend Ben sees his sad face.
Ben gives Sam half of his sandwich and an apple.
Oh no, he forgot his lunch at home!
"Thank you, Ben!" says Sam with a big smile.
why: 벤은 샘의 슬픈 얼굴을 보고, 자기 점심을 나누어 줘요. 두 문장을 이어야 알 수 있어요.
Ben sees Sam's sad face, and then he shares his lunch. You need both sentences.

ends: The next day, Sam shares his cookies with Ben.
다음 날, 샘이 벤에게 쿠키를 나누어 준다.
Sam and Ben make lunch together.
샘과 벤이 함께 점심 도시락을 만든다.

write.howtoKo: 예문을 틀로 삼아, 빈칸 두 곳을 «할 수 없는 일 + 대신 할 수 있는 일» 로 바꿔 영어로 써 보세요.
write.howtoEn: Use the example as a pattern. Write what you can’t do and what you can do instead in English.
write.moreKo: 한 걸음 더: 두 칸 모두 «하는 일» 낱말로 시작하게 써 보세요. (예: play soccer, draw a picture)
write.moreEn: One more step: start both blanks with an action word. (e.g. play soccer, draw a picture)
write.src: “I can’t <u>eat my lunch</u>, but I can <u>share Ben’s sandwich</u>.”
